spans.s: प्रभंजन (I) m. Air, wind.
प्रभंजन (II) n. Breaking to pieces.
प्राभंजन n. An epithet of the lunar mansion Svātī.
प्रभद्र m. The Nimba tree.

प्रभव m. 1. Birth, production; 2. source, origin, तस्यान्विष्यन्वेतसगूढं प्रभवं सः R.ix.75, i.2, Sis.ix.42, K.S.v.77; 3. the operative cause; 4. the source (of a river), तस्या एव प्रभवमचलं प्राप्य गौरं तुषारैः Megh.i.52; 5. power, strength, valour; 6. the creator, K.S.ii.5; 7. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रभाव m. 1. Brilliance, splendour; 2. glory, dignity, grandeur; 3. power, strength, valour; 4. miraculous or superhuman power, R.ii.41, iii.40, K.S.vii.36; 5. magnanimity.
प्राभव n. Superiority, supremacy.
प्रभवितृ m. A great lord.
प्रभविष्णु m. 1. A lord, a master; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्रभा f. 1. Light, splendour, radiance, प्रभा पतंगस्य मुनेश्च धेनुः R.ii.15, vi.18, Bg.vii.8; 2. a ray of light, Megh.i.47; 3. an epithet of Durgā; 4. a name of the city of Kubera; 5. name of an Apsaras.
प्रभा-कर m. 1. the sun, R.x.74; 2. the moon; 3. fire; 4. the ocean; 5. an epithet of Śiva; 6. name of a learned author, the founder of that school of the Mīmānsā philosophy which goes by his name.
प्राभाकर m. A follower of the Prabhākara school of the Mīmānsā philosophy.
प्रभा-कीट m. a firefly.
प्रभा-तरल a. tremulously radiant, न प्रभातरलं ज्योतिरुदेति वसुधातलात् Sak.i.
प्रभा-मंडल n. a circle of light, R.iii.60.
प्रभा-लेपिन् a. covered with splendour.
प्रभाग m. 1. Division; 2. the fraction of a fraction (in math.).
प्रभात (I) a. (f. ता) Begun to become light, e.g. ननु प्रभाता रजनी.
प्रभात (II) n. Dawn, daybreak, Bh.V.iii.4.
प्रभात (I) a. (f. ता) Begun to become light, e.g. ननु प्रभाता रजनी.
प्रभान n. Light, lustre, radiance.
प्रभाव-ज a. proceeding from majesty.
प्रभाषण n. Explanation, interpretation.
प्रभास (I) m. Splendour, beauty.
प्रभास (II) m.n. Name of a place of pilgrimage near Dvārakā.
प्रभासन n. Illumining, brightening.
प्रभास्वर a. (f. रा) Brilliant, shining.
प्रभास्वर a. (f. रा) Brilliant, shining.
प्रभिन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Severed, divided; 2. broken to pieces; 3. budded, opened, expanded; 4. altered, changed, deformed; 5. loosened, (pp. of भिद् with प्र q.v.).
प्रभिन्न (II) m. An elephant in rut.
प्रभिन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) 1. Severed, divided; 2. broken to pieces; 3. budded, opened, expanded; 4. altered, changed, deformed; 5. loosened, (pp. of भिद् with प्र q.v.).
प्रभिन्न-अंजन n. a kind of collyrium mixed with oil.

प्रभु (I) a. (f. भु or भ्वी) 1. Mighty, powerful; 2. competent, able (generally with an inf.), ऋषिप्रभावान्मयि नांतकोऽपि प्रभुः प्रहर्तुं किमुतान्यहिंस्राः R.ii.62; 3. a match for, (with a dat.), e.g. प्रभुर्मल्लो मल्लाय.
प्रभु (II) m. 1. a superior, a governor, a master, a lord; 2. an owner, a proprietor; 3. quick-silver; 4. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 5. of Viṣṇu; 6. of Śiva; 7. of Indra, R.iii.65.

प्रभु (I) a. (f. भु or भ्वी) 1. Mighty, powerful; 2. competent, able (generally with an inf.), ऋषिप्रभावान्मयि नांतकोऽपि प्रभुः प्रहर्तुं किमुतान्यहिंस्राः R.ii.62; 3. a match for, (with a dat.), e.g. प्रभुर्मल्लो मल्लाय.
प्रभु-ता f. supremacy, sovereignty, power.
प्रभूत a. (f. ता) 1. Sprung from; 2. much, abundant, numerous, many; 3. mature, perfect; 4. high, lofty.
प्रभूत a. (f. ता) 1. Sprung from; 2. much, abundant, numerous, many; 3. mature, perfect; 4. high, lofty.
प्रभु-त्व n. supremacy, sovereignty, power.
प्रभु-भक्त m. a good horse.
प्रभु-भक्ति f. attachment to a lord, faithfulness.
प्रभूत-वयस् a. old, advanced in years.
प्रभूति f. 1. Source, origin; 2. power, strength.
प्रभृति (I) f. Beginning, commencement, (in this sense, the word generally occurs as the last member of a Bahu. compound, Yaj.i.264).
प्रभृति (II) ind. Beginning with, from, since, (with an abl.), e.g. बाल्यात् प्रभृति, अद्य प्रभृति, ततः प्रभृति &c. K.S.iii.26, R.xi.28.
प्रभेद m. 1. Splitting, opening; 2. the flowing of ichor from the temples of an elephant, R.iii.37; 3. difference, distinction.
प्रभ्रंश m. Falling, fall.
प्रभ्रंशथु m. A particular disease of the nose.
प्रभ्रष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Fallen, dropped.
प्रभ्रष्ट (II) n. A chaplet of flowers suspended from the lock on the head.
प्रभ्रष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Fallen, dropped.
प्रभ्रष्टक n. See प्रभ्रष्ट II.
प्राभंजनि m. 1. An epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
प्राभवत्य n. Supremacy, authority, M.viii.412.
प्राभातिक a. (f. की) Relating to the morning.
प्राभातिक a. (f. की) Relating to the morning.
प्राभृत n. 1. A present, a gift; 2. an offering to a deity or to a king; 3. a bribe.
प्राभृत n. 1. A present, a gift; 2. an offering to a deity or to a king; 3. a bribe.
